name: android.observe
description: Read UI controls/content (auto-diffs; full:true forces full, image:always|if_needed|only, detail:debug).

name: android.open
description: Open package (+activity), url, settingsAction, activityTaskId, intent, or share.

name: android.tap
description: Tap selector, target+observation, or x+y (+screenshotId). holdMs long-presses.

name: android.type
description: Type text into selector/target (mode:replace|insert), or into the focused field with focused:true+screenshotId (from observe image:always).

name: android.key
description: Send key (BACK, ENTER, TAB, DEL, SPACE, A-Z, 0-9, DPAD_*, HOME, VOLUME_*, etc.).

name: android.gesture
description: Run swipe/drag (x1,y1,x2,y2), pinch (centerX,centerY,startSpan,endSpan), or paths ([[{x,y}]]).

name: android.scroll
description: Scroll in direction. Container: selector or target+observation; none uses the largest scroll area (app 2.0.10+). until: selector to stop at (+maxScrolls 1-20).

name: android.wait
description: Wait for verify {conditions:[{kind,...}],match?:all|any}.

name: android.sequence
description: Run up to 12 UI steps [{tool,arguments,before?,optional?}] ("previous"/"step:0" refs).

name: android.task
description: Sessions: begin (optional package/url/intent/join; mode:foreground+confirmed:true), inspect, list, finish, share, handoff, record_start/record_stop/record_status.

name: android.devices
description: List devices (detail:debug adds battery/network).

name: android.packages
description: Search installed apps or inspect one package.

name: android.logs
description: Read logcat, crash, ANR, or jank (needs package).

name: android.install
description: Install APK from source {url} or {path}.

name: android.confirm
description: Ask user on Android device to approve an action (kind:confirm) or take over the live screen for sign-in, 2FA, CAPTCHA, or manual help (kind:handoff).

name: android.personal
description: Shortcuts: recent_photos, contacts, alarm, timer, inbox.

name: android.events
description: Pushed events (list), triggers (rules/set_rules), webhooks (webhook_set/webhook_clear).

name: android.notification
description: Notifications: list, open, action, reply, dismiss.

name: android.shell
description: Run background shell command.

name: android.file
description: Files: pull (single-call for large files with saveTo or download URL), push, fetch.

name: android.device
description: Utilities: clipboard (no text reads, text writes), media (no action reads now playing), location, control (volume/rotation/wifi/bluetooth), brightness (no value reads, value 0-255 sets; app 2.0.10+), audio. Screen recording is android.task record_start.

name: android.developer
description: Run package stop/uninstall/grant/clear_data or instrumentation test.

name: android.maintenance
description: Update Backstage and reconnect; check device state before retrying after restart.
